descriptionHtml:
The first webinar of Robotrics 21/22 phase 1, organised by the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society, the student chapter of University of Peradeniya, was held on 11th of July 2021 from 4.00 p.m via zoom platform and Facebook live. The webinar was conducted by a senior lecturer in the Department of Electronic and Electrical Engineering, University of Peradeniya, who has practised and gained good knowledge in various fields such as bio robotics and biomechanical simulation of locomotor control, dynamics of sensory-motor integration and many more technical fields.

 The webinar was opened for all the undergraduates interested in Robotics and who plan to succeed in the Robotics Industry in the future.

The main topics discussed were, 

  • What is Webots?
  • Alternatives to Webots?
  • Portfolio and features
  • Webots simulations and user interface
  • Examples and Tutorials

At the commencement of the event, an introduction of the keynote speaker was delivered. Afterwards, Dr. Nalin Harischandra started to discuss Webots Simulation software from the basics and presented various robotics projects which are created from the Webots platform. Further, he clarified the languages that can be written in Webots controller.

At the end of the main session of the guest speaker, the participants were able to lighten their minds moreover in the Q/A session, where they were able to get answers to a lot of questions and clarify their doubts regarding the Webot simulation software and how to get started robots modelling in Webots platform as robotics enthusiasts.

Finally, to remark the end of the first webinar of the webinar series, the Vote of Thanks was delivered by Udula Ranasinghe, the secretary of IEEE Robotics and Automation Society.
